summary_zh: 开源AI代码审查代理，可作为PR评论或命令行工具生成描述、审查、改进建议，支持就PR提问及查找相似issue。支持GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps、Gitea，可本地或自托管部署，并可接入多种大模型。它是Qodo社区维护的开源项目，并非Qodo免费版。
audience_zh: 适合使用上述Git平台、希望以开源方式为拉取请求引入自动审查与描述生成的开发团队；也适合需要自托管、可自定义提示词并自由选择AI模型、重视数据与基础设施掌控的开发者及开源维护者。

evidence.quote: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.

PR-Agent is an open-source, AI-powered code review agent and a community-maintained legacy project of Qodo. It is distinct from Qodo's primary AI code review offering, which provides a feature-rich, context-aware experience. Qodo offers a free version for open-source projects and integrates seamless
ly with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps for high-quality automated reviews.
